why_it_matters: Shows which dollars funded which project, capex, acquisition, debt repayment, or payout.
upgrade_if_found: Upgrade broad treasury capacity into named source/use funding evidence.

why_it_matters: Connects funded assets/projects to actual cash generation.

safe_claim: Project/asset contribution is the recurring source needed to move from company cash proxy to asset return.
